patents.title: CONSTRUCTIONS DE RÉCEPTEURS ANTIGÉNIQUES CHIMÉRIQUES
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides CAR (chimeric antigen receptor) constructs, T cell populations having the CAR(s), and methods of treating cancer with the T cell populations.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent covers CAR construct designs and engineered T cell populations expressing these CARs for cancer treatment. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T lies in potential innovations in CAR architecture, T cell manufacturing, or tumor targeting specificity, though the abstract does not specify the particular novel features that differentiate these constructs from prior art.

patents.title: PROCÉDÉ DE PRÉPARATION DE NANOPARTICULES LIPIDIQUES CIBLÉES
patents.abstract: The present invention relates to processes for preparing lipid nanoparticles having an antibody or fragment antibody binding region.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent describes processes for preparing lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) functionalized with antibody or antibody fragment binding regions for targeted delivery. This is significant for in vivo CAR-T applications as targeted LNPs could enhance delivery of mRNA encoding CAR constructs to specific cell populations, improving therapeutic efficacy and reducing off-target effects compared to non-targeted LNP delivery systems.

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS D'ADMINISTRATION
patents.abstract: This disclosure provides, for instance, novel lipids suitable for use in lipid nanoparticles, for therapeutic delivery of nucleic acids. Also provided are methods of making and using the lipids.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses novel lipid structures optimized for lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulations designed to improve nucleic acid delivery efficiency. This is competitively significant for in vivo CAR-T applications as superior LNP-based delivery systems can enhance mRNA delivery for CAR construct expression, potentially improving transfection rates and reducing off-target immunogenicity compared to existing ionizable lipid platforms.

patents.title: SYSTÈMES D'ÉLÉMENTS GÉNÉTIQUES MOBILES MODIFIÉS
patents.abstract: Systems and methods for targeted insertion. Engineered nucleic acid targeting systems comprise components of non-LTR retrotransposon elements. Specifically, the recombinant mobile element systems of the present disclosure are derived from R2Tg, a non-long terminal repeat (nLTR) retrotransposon from the zebra finch Taeniopygia guttata.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses engineered non-LTR retrotransposon systems derived from R2Tg elements for targeted nucleic acid insertion. This represents a novel delivery platform distinct from conventional viral vectors, potentially offering advantages in specificity and reduced immunogenicity for therapeutic gene insertion applications in cell engineering.

patents.title: NUCLÉASES CAS9-IID MODIFIÉES ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Described herein are systems, methods, and compositions capable of targeting nucleic acids. Describe in certain exemplary embodiments herein are a class of small Cas proteins (Type II-D Cas proteins) and systems thereof. Also described in certain exemplary embodiments herein are methods of modifying target sequences using the class of small Cas proteins (Type II-D Cas proteins) and systems thereof described herein.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes modified Type II-D Cas9 nucleases (smaller Cas proteins) and their use for nucleic acid targeting and sequence modification. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T lies in potential delivery advantages: smaller Cas9 variants are more amenable to viral vector packaging (e.g., AAV) compared to standard SpCas9, which could enable more efficient in vivo T cell engineering and reduced off-target effects through improved dosing control.

patents.title: NUCLÉASES ISCB MODIFIÉES, ARN GUIDES MODIFIÉS ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Disclosed herein are novel polypeptides having nuclease activity. The polypeptides can effect modifications at defined locations within target nucleic acids, e.g., DNA and RNA. Also disclosed herein modified guide RNAs. The polypeptides and guide RNAs are useful in compositions, systems and methods, to make site specific alterations of target nucleic acid sequences.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses novel modified CRISPR-Cas nuclease polypeptides and engineered guide RNAs that enable precise site-specific modifications of target DNA and RNA sequences. This is relevant to CAR-T gene therapy as improved nuclease specificity and edited guide RNA designs could enhance the safety and efficacy of T cell genetic engineering by reducing off-target editing and improving on-target CAR transgene insertion.

patents.title: CAPSIDES ENDOGÈNES DE LA FAMILLE DE GAG ET DE DE PNMA ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Disclosed herein, in certain embodiments, are recombinant PNMA family and endogenous Gag polypeptides, capsids comprising the recombinant PNMA or endogenous Gag polypeptides, and methods of making and using recombinant PNMA and endogenous Gag polypeptides.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses recombinant PNMA family and endogenous Gag-derived polypeptides and capsids as potentially novel delivery vehicles, distinct from conventional viral vectors. For in vivo CAR-T applications, these endogenous capsid structures could offer a platform for intracellular delivery of genetic material with potentially reduced immunogenicity compared to exogenous viral systems.

patents.title: CAPSIDES CONTENANT UN PNMA2 ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Disclosed herein, in certain embodiments, are recombinant PNMA2 and endogenous Gag polypeptides, capsids comprising the recombinant PNMA2 or endogenous Gag polypeptides, and methods of making and using recombinant PNMA2 and endogenous Gag polypeptides.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; UNIV UTAH RES FOUND [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses novel capsid compositions incorporating recombinant PNMA2 and endogenous Gag polypeptides, along with methods for their manufacture and use. PNMA2-containing capsids represent a potentially differentiated viral-like particle or VLP platform that could enable targeted intracellular delivery to specific cell types, offering competitive advantage for precision gene therapy applications where cell-type selectivity is critical.

patents.title: ARC-BASED CAPSIDS AND USES THEREOF
patents.abstract: [0000]    Disclosed herein, in certain embodiments, are recombinant Arc and endogenous Gag polypeptides, and methods of using recombinant Arc and endogenous Gag polypeptides.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; Aera Therapeutics, Inc.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses recombinant Arc-based capsids (derived from Activity-Regulated Cytoskeleton-associated protein) combined with endogenous Gag polypeptides as a novel delivery platform. This represents a potentially significant alternative to AAV and lentiviral vectors for intracellular delivery, with potential applications in gene therapy including T cell engineering, though specific CAR-T applications are not explicitly detailed in the abstract.

patents.title: ARC-BASED CAPSIDS AND USES THEREOF
patents.abstract: To provide new capsids for delivering therapeutic payloads.SOLUTION: A capsid comprises a recombinant Arc polypeptide or a recombinant endogenous Gag polypeptide, and a therapeutic agent. The therapeutic agent may be a nucleic acid. The nucleic acid may be an RNA. The recombinant Arc polypeptide may be a human Arc polypeptide comprising specific amino acid sequences. The recombinant endogenous Gag polypeptide may be a human endogenous gag polypeptide.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC; アエラ  セラピューティクス，  インク．
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes novel capsids based on Arc polypeptides and endogenous Gag polypeptides engineered to deliver therapeutic payloads, particularly RNA. This represents a non-viral delivery platform using endogenous human proteins, offering a potentially safer and more immunologically inert alternative to viral vectors for in vivo gene delivery applications.

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR TREATING CANCER WITH ARGININE DEPLETION AND IMMUNO ONCOLOGY AGENTS
patents.assignee: AERASE INC [US]; AERase, Inc.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes combinations of arginine depletion agents with immuno-oncology agents (potentially including CAR-T cells) for cancer treatment. The novelty lies in the synergistic approach of depleting arginine—a metabolic vulnerability in the tumor microenvironment—to enhance immunotherapy efficacy, which could reduce tumor immunosuppression and improve CAR-T cell functionality in vivo.

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR TREATING CANCER WITH ARGININE DEPLETION AND IMMUNO ONCOLOGY AGENTS
patents.abstract: [0001a]    [종양 또는 암을 치료하는 방법은 아르기닌 고갈 효소 및 면역-종양학 작용제를 투여하는 것을 포함한다.]
patents.assignee: AERASE INC [US]; 에어레이즈, 인크.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent combines arginine depletion enzymes with immuno-oncology agents for cancer treatment, presenting a synergistic approach to enhance immune response by metabolic modulation. This combination strategy is potentially significant for in vivo CAR-T therapies by addressing the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment through arginine starvation, which could improve CAR-T cell persistence, expansion, and anti-tumor efficacy.

patents.title: ZUSAMMENSETZUNGEN AUS MANIPULIERTEN MENSCHLICHEN ARGINASEN UND VERFAHREN ZUR BEHANDLUNG VON KREBS
patents.abstract: Described are pharmaceutical compositions and medical uses of engineered human arginases, and particularly, among others, a pharmaceutical formulation comprising a protein comprising an amino acid sequence of human Arginase I and a non-native metal cofactor, wherein the non-native metal cofactor is cobalt; a pharmaceutical formulation comprising a human Arginase I protein having a metal binding site and comprising at least one amino acid substitution at the metal binding site, wherein the protein displays an increase in the hydrolysis of Arginine that results in a kcat /Km of at least two fold greater than that of a native human Arginase I; a pharmaceutical formulation comprising a fusion protein comprising any of the said proteins; as well as medical uses related to the above.
patents.assignee: AERASE INC [US]; AERase, Inc.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered human arginase variants with non-native metal cofactors (cobalt) or amino acid substitutions that enhance arginine hydrolysis activity (>2-fold improvement in kcat/Km). This is relevant to CAR-T therapy as arginine depletion is an immunosuppressive mechanism in the tumor microenvironment; engineered arginases could potentiate CAR-T efficacy by alleviating arginine limitation, a known metabolic constraint on T cell function and persistence.

patents.title: SYSTÈMES DE DÉLIVRANCE À CAPSIDE NON ENVELOPPÉE ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Disclosed herein, in certain embodiments, are non-enveloped capsid delivery systems which comprise a viral capsid polypeptide and a heterologous cargo, as well as methods of making and using such non-enveloped capsid delivery systems.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses non-enveloped viral capsid delivery systems combining viral capsid polypeptides with heterologous cargo, along with manufacturing and utilization methods. This is potentially significant for in vivo CAR-T and gene therapy as non-enveloped capsids (such as AAV or adeno-associated viral variants) offer improved tissue penetration, reduced immunogenicity compared to enveloped systems, and potential for safer systemic delivery of therapeutic payloads including CAR-T programming vectors.

patents.title: CAPSIDES COMPRENANT DES CONJUGUÉS EFFECTEUR-POLYPEPTIDE ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: The present invention is directed to a capsid containing (a) an endogenous Gag polypeptide, (b) one or more effector-polypeptide conjugates, where each effector-polypeptide conjugate independently comprises an endogenous Gag polypeptide, and (c) optionally a heterologous cargo, such as an mRNA or siRNA.
patents.assignee: AERA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; AERA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes capsids incorporating effector-polypeptide conjugates fused to endogenous Gag polypeptides, enabling delivery of heterologous cargo (mRNA, siRNA) with enhanced functional capacity. This modular capsid architecture with targeted effector domains could provide improved delivery specificity and payload capacity for in vivo gene therapy applications, including potential CAR-T applications requiring efficient mRNA delivery to T cells.

patents.title: VACCINS ANTICANCÉREUX ANTI-IDO1 ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Provided herein are nucleic acids, pharmaceutical compositions and vaccines that express a cancer antigen comprising IDO1. Also provided herein are methods for treating a cancer.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents nucleic acid-based cancer vaccines targeting IDO1, an immunosuppressive enzyme commonly upregulated in tumors. The approach combines IDO1 as a cancer antigen with vaccine formulations, offering potential synergy with checkpoint inhibitors and adoptive cell therapies by reducing the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment—a significant advantage for combination strategies with CAR-T cells.

patents.title: VACCINS CONTRE LE CANCER PD-L1 ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Provided herein are nucleic acids, pharmaceutical compositions and vaccines that express a cancer antigen comprising PD-L1. Also provided herein are methods for treating a cancer.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses nucleic acid-based vaccines expressing PD-L1 as a cancer antigen, combined with methods for cancer treatment. The competitive significance lies in using PD-L1 as an immunogenic target rather than a checkpoint inhibitor, potentially combining vaccine-induced immunity with checkpoint modulation for enhanced anti-tumor response.

patents.title: VACCINS CONTRE LE CANCER ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Provided herein are nucleic acids, pharmaceutical compositions and vaccines that express one or more cancer antigen comprising PD-L1 and/or IDO1. Also provided herein are methods for treating a cancer.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES SINGAPORE PTE LTD [SG]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers nucleic acid-based cancer vaccines expressing PD-L1 and/or IDO1 antigens, targeting immunosuppressive checkpoints as therapeutic cancer antigens rather than conventional tumor-associated antigens. This represents a novel immunological approach by converting immune escape mechanisms into vaccine targets, potentially synergizing with CAR-T and checkpoint inhibitor therapies to enhance anti-tumor immunity.

patents.title: LIPIDES CONTENANT DU POLYSARCOSINE ET COMPOSITIONS, PRÉPARATION ET UTILISATIONS ASSOCIÉES
patents.abstract: Provided are compounds of Formula 1, stereoisomers of the compounds, pharmaceutically acceptable salts of the foregoing, compositions comprising the foregoing, and methods of using the foregoing, including use in treating a disease or disorder in a subject.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: Novel lipid compounds containing polysarcosine moieties designed for therapeutic delivery applications. These polysarcosine-based lipids represent a differentiated approach to formulation chemistry that could offer advantages in mRNA or nucleic acid delivery through improved biocompatibility, reduced immunogenicity, and enhanced cellular uptake compared to conventional ionizable lipids.

patents.title: VACCIN THÉRAPEUTIQUE À BASE D'ARN MESSAGER DE BIRC5 CONTRE LE CANCER
patents.abstract: Provided is a fusion polypeptide comprises (i) a first polypeptide comprising BIRC5 protein; and (ii) a second polypeptide comprising major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I transmembrane and trafficking domain (MITD), a nucleic acid encoding the fusion polypeptide, and a vaccine comprising an RNA polynucleotide that encodes the fusion polypeptide. Provided is a method of treating a cancer in the subject by administering to the subject a therapeutically effective amount of the vaccine.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fusion polypeptide combining BIRC5 (survivin) antigen with MHC class I transmembrane and trafficking domain (MITD) formulated as an mRNA vaccine for cancer immunotherapy. This approach is novel in linking a validated cancer-associated antigen (BIRC5/survivin, highly expressed in multiple cancers) with MHC presentation enhancement via MITD, potentially improving CD8+ T cell recognition and therapeutic efficacy in solid tumors and hematologic malignancies.

patents.title: VACCIN THÉRAPEUTIQUE ANTICANCÉREUX À BASE D'ARNM LY6K
patents.abstract: Provided herein are a fusion polypeptide comprises (i) a first polypeptide comprising LY6K protein; and (ii) a second polypeptide comprising major histocompatibility complex (MHC) class I transmembrane and trafficking domain (MITD), nucleic acids encoding the fusion polypeptide, a vaccine comprising an RNA polynucleotide that encodes the fusion polypeptide, wherein the vaccine is formulated in a lipid nanoparticle, and a method of treating a cancer in the subject by administering to the subject a therapeutically effective amount of the vaccine.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents an mRNA vaccine encoding an LY6K-MHC class I fusion protein delivered via lipid nanoparticles for cancer immunotherapy. The novelty lies in coupling a tumor-associated antigen (LY6K) with MHC class I trafficking machinery to enhance antigen presentation and immune activation, representing a differentiated approach to therapeutic cancer vaccination that complements CAR-T by leveraging endogenous T cell recognition pathways.

patents.title: VACCINS CONTRE LE CANCER ET LEURS UTILISATIONS
patents.abstract: Provided herein are nucleic acids, pharmaceutical compositions and vaccines that express a cancer antigen (e.g., PRAME). Also provided herein are methods for treating a cancer.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES II HK LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers nucleic acid-based cancer vaccines expressing tumor-associated antigens (exemplified by PRAME) and associated pharmaceutical compositions, along with therapeutic methods for cancer treatment. For in vivo CAR-T applications, this represents a complementary immunotherapeutic approach rather than direct CAR-T technology—the vaccine could enhance CAR-T efficacy through antigen priming or work synergistically in combination regimens.

patents.title: PARTICULES D'ARN-LIPIDE COMPRENANT UN CONJUGUÉ POLYSARCOSINE-LIPIDE
patents.abstract: Provided are RNA-lipid particles and formulations comprising novel lipids and therapeutic agents, methods of preparing RNA-lipid particles, and methods of delivering and/or administering RNA-lipid particles. In particular, provided are RNA-lipid particles comprising a polysarcosine-based lipid conjugate or a conjugate of polysarcosine and lipid-like material, and RNA such as single-stranded messenger RNA which encodes a peptide or protein of interest, and methods of preparing the RNA-lipid particles. The particles comprising mRNA and polysarcosine are delivered to target tissues after administered via intramuscular, intravenous, or subcutaneous route.
patents.assignee: EVEREST MEDICINES CHINA CO LTD [CN]; EVEREST MEDICINES SINGAPORE PTE LTD [SG]; EVEREST MEDICINES (CHINA) CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent discloses RNA-lipid particles formulated with novel polysarcosine-lipid conjugates for mRNA delivery via multiple routes (IM, IV, SC). The polysarcosine-based lipid component represents a differentiated ionizable lipid architecture that could improve mRNA delivery efficiency, biodistribution, and transfection profiles compared to conventional lipid nanoparticles, with potential application to CAR-T manufacturing through ex vivo mRNA delivery to T cells.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEURS ANTIGÉNIQUES CHIMÉRIQUES CIBLANT BCMA
patents.abstract: Provided herein are RNA sequences encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) comprising a B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA) binding molecule, along with related compositions and methods. In some embodiments, circular RNAs encoding the BCMA binding molecule or BCMA CAR, along with related compositions, methods, and precursors, are described herein. In some embodiments, these compositions comprise a transfer vehicle, e.g., comprising an ionizable lipid described herein.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; RENAGADE THERAPEUTICS MAN INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers circular RNA (circRNA) encoding BCMA-targeting CAR molecules formulated with ionizable lipid-based transfer vehicles, representing a novel delivery approach for in vivo CAR-T therapy. This circular RNA platform offers potential advantages over linear mRNA in terms of stability and reduced immunogenicity, providing competitive differentiation in the rapidly growing CAR-T space, particularly for hematologic malignancies where BCMA is a validated target.

patents.title: SITES D'ENTRÉE INTERNE DES RIBOSOMES SYNTHÉTIQUES
patents.abstract: Circular RNA and precursor RNA polynucleotides comprising synthetic, non-naturally occurring, Internal Ribosome Entry Sites (IRES), along with related compositions and methods are described herein. In some embodiments, the synthetic IRESs comprise at least one addition, deletion, or substitution of a nucleotide, domain, or motif, as compared to a naturally occurring IRES. In some embodiments, the synthetic IRESs have improved function and/or expression and/or stability as compared to a naturally occurring IRES and/or are capable of increasing expression of operably linked expression sequences as compared to naturally occurring IRESs. Also presented herein are methods and compositions for the manufacture and preparation of the circularized RNAs comprising the synthetic IRESs, along with methods of administering said circular RNAs and related compositions to a subject in need thereof for treatment or prevention purposes.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes synthetic, non-naturally occurring Internal Ribosome Entry Sites (IRES) with engineered modifications (additions, deletions, substitutions) that exhibit improved function, expression, and/or stability compared to natural IRES elements, particularly in circular RNA platforms. This is competitively significant for CAR-T as optimized IRES elements could enhance cap-independent translation of CAR transgenes and other therapeutic proteins in T cells, potentially improving CAR-T manufacturing efficiency and in vivo expression kinetics.

patents.title: MÉTHODES ET COMPOSITIONS D'ARN CIRCULAIRE
patents.abstract: Circular RNA, along with related compositions, methods, and precursor RNA, are described herein. In some embodiments, the composition comprises a transfer vehicle and a circular RNA comprising a 3' self-spliced exon segment, a translation initiation element (TIE), an expression sequence encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), and a 5' self-spliced exon segment. In some embodiments, the transfer vehicle comprises an ionizable lipid disclosed herein. In some embodiments, the circular RNA and/or composition thereof has improved expression, functional stability, immunogenicity, ease of manufacturing, and/or half-life as compared to linear RNA. Also presented herein are methods and compositions for the manufacture and preparation of circularized RNAs, along with methods of administering said circular RNAs and related compositions to a subject in need thereof for treatment or prevention purposes.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; RENAGADE THERAPEUTICS MAN INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes circular RNA (circRNA) compositions encoding chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) formulated with ionizable lipids, demonstrating improved expression, stability, immunogenicity, and manufacturability compared to linear RNA equivalents. This represents a significant competitive advantage for in vivo CAR-T by potentially enabling non-viral delivery of CAR transgenes with enhanced durability and reduced innate immune activation, addressing key manufacturing and translational barriers in cell therapy.

patents.title: LIPIDES DE POLYÉTHYLÈNE GLYCOL À DÉTACHEMENT RAPIDE
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides PEG lipids and transfer vehicle compositions including the same. Incorporation of the PEG lipids of this disclosure into a transfer vehicle can provide for one or more desirable properties, including low immune response and/or immunogenicity, fast-shedding of the PEG lipid from the transfer vehicle, and/or degradability of the PEG lipid, e.g., via ester hydrolysis or cleavage.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; RENAGADE THERAPEUTICS MAN INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses PEG lipids with rapid shedding kinetics and degradability features (via ester hydrolysis) designed for transfer vehicle formulations, offering reduced immunogenicity and improved PEG clearance compared to conventional PEG-lipid conjugates. This is competitively significant for in vivo CAR-T delivery as rapid PEG shedding can enhance initial cellular uptake while minimizing prolonged immune activation, particularly relevant for systemic RNA/viral vector delivery platforms used in ex vivo CAR-T manufacturing or in vivo T cell targeting.

patents.title: NANOPARTICULES LIPIDIQUES COMPRENANT DES MOLÉCULES D'ARN CODANT DESTINÉES À ÊTRE UTILISÉES DANS L'ÉDITION DE GÈNES ET EN TANT QUE VACCINS ET AGENTS THÉRAPEUTIQUES
patents.abstract: The present disclosure describes improved LNP-based RNA vaccines, nucleobase editing systems, and therapeutics for use in treating and/or immunization against disease. In particular, the disclosure describes improved LNPs, including novel and improved ionizable lipids for making LNPs, that enhance the targeted delivery of LNP-based RNA vaccines and therapeutics based on linear and/or circular mRNAs. The improved LNPs protect linear and/or circular mRNA payloads from degradation and clearance while achieving targeted systemic or local delivery for use as enhanced vaccines and/or therapeutic agents.
patents.assignee: RENAGADE THERAPEUTICS MAN INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; RENAGADE THERAPEUTICS MANAGEMENT INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes improved lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) with novel ionizable lipids designed to enhance targeted delivery of linear and/or circular mRNA payloads while protecting them from degradation. The competitive significance for in vivo CAR-T is moderate, as LNPs are critical delivery vehicles for mRNA-based CAR-T manufacturing ex vivo and for in vivo delivery of mRNA therapeutics, though this patent appears focused primarily on vaccines and general gene editing rather than CAR-T engineering specifically.

patents.title: PROCÉDÉ DE FABRICATION DE NANOPARTICULES LIPIDIQUES
patents.abstract: The present application provides methods for manufacturing lipid nanoparticles. The present disclosure provides methods of preparing empty lipid nanoparticles (empty LNPs). The present disclosure provides methods of preparing loaded lipid nanoparticles (loaded LNPs) associated with a nucleic acid. Empty and loaded LNP compositions prepared by the subject methods are also provided. There is provided a homogeneous LNP composition of empty or loaded LNPs of particularly favorable average particle size and poly dispersity index.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses methods for manufacturing lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) with optimized particle size distribution and polydispersity index, along with compositions of empty and nucleic acid-loaded LNPs. This is relevant to gene therapy delivery, as LNPs are critical non-viral vectors for in vivo delivery of therapeutic nucleic acids including mRNA and DNA therapeutics to T cells and other cell types.

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS D'ARN CIRCULAIRE
patents.abstract: Provided herein are circular RNA constructs comprising an IRES, and at least one expression sequence encoding binding molecule, compositions thereof, and methods of treating autoimmune disease. In particular, circular RNA comprising an IRES and a CD19 binder or a BCMA binder are provided, optionally formulated with a delivery vehicle. Precursor polynucleotides comprising an IRES, and at least one expression sequence encoding a CAR construct are also described herein.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents circular RNA (circRNA) constructs incorporating IRES elements and expression sequences for CAR constructs (CD19 and BCMA binders), representing a novel delivery platform for engineered T cell therapeutics. The use of circRNA as a vehicle for CAR expression offers potential advantages in terms of stability, reduced immunogenicity, and manufacturing efficiency compared to conventional viral or mRNA-based delivery approaches, with direct application to in vivo CAR-T manufacturing and autoimmune disease treatment.

patents.title: LIPIDES CIRCULAIRES DE POLYÉTHYLÈNE GLYCOL
patents.abstract: The present application provides, circular polymeric lipid compounds, and methods for preparing and using the same. The circular polymeric lipid compounds can comprise a macrocycle comprising one or more polymer blocks, such as one or more polyethylene glycol (PEG) blocks, and at least one lipid. In some embodiments, one or more lipids are covalently attached to the macrocycle and is outside the macrocycle's backbone. In some embodiments, the macrocycle includes two lipids within the macrocycle's backbone, wherein all the polymeric blocks are between the two lipids. The present application also provides methods of preparing the subject circular polymeric lipid compounds, and their use in lipid nanoparticle formulations.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent describes novel circular polymeric lipid compounds with PEG blocks and covalently attached lipids, designed for lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulations. The circular architecture and strategic positioning of lipids offer potential advantages in LNP stability, cellular uptake, and delivery efficiency—critical parameters for in vivo CAR-T cell therapies requiring efficient mRNA or DNA delivery to engineer T cells.

patents.title: COMPOSITIONS DE NANOPARTICULES LIPIDIQUES POLYMÈRES POUR L'ADMINISTRATION DE POLYNUCLÉOTIDES CIRCULAIRES
patents.abstract: Disclosed herein are compositions comprising polymeric lipid nanoparticles, and methods for preparing the same. The polymeric lipid nanoparticles can comprise RNA polynucleotides, such as circular RNA polynucleotides (circRNA), ionizable lipids (lipid) and amphiphilic polymers, thereby forming a polymeric lipid nanoparticle composition. In some embodiments, the lipid forms a complex with the circRNA (circRNA-lipid complex) that is encapsulated in the nanoparticles. In some embodiments, the circRNA-lipid complex is encapsulated in the core of the nanoparticles and the amphiphilic polymer provides a uniform shell around the circRNA-lipid complex. The present application also provides emulsions comprising the polymeric lipid nanoparticles.
patents.assignee: ORNA THERAPEUTICS INC [US]; ORNA THERAPEUTICS, INC.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents polymeric lipid nanoparticles (PLNPs) incorporating circular RNA (circRNA) with a dual-layer architecture: an ionizable lipid-circRNA core complex surrounded by an amphiphilic polymer shell. This architecture is novel for circRNA delivery and offers potential competitive advantages for in vivo CAR-T applications through improved stability, reduced immunogenicity, and sustained expression compared to linear mRNA delivery systems.

patents.title: MÉTHODES ET COMPOSITIONS D'ARN CIRCULAIRE
patents.abstract: Circular RNA and precursor RNA polynucleotides, along with related compositions and methods are described herein. In some embodiments, the circular RNA comprises, in the following order, a 3' self-spliced exon segment, an intervening region, and a 5' self-spliced exon segment. In some embodiments, the precursor RNA is a linear RNA comprising a 5' combined accessory element comprising a 3' permuted intron segment; an intervening region; and a 3' combined accessory element comprising a 5' permuted intron segment. In some embodiments, the circular RNA and/or precursor RNA polynucleotides comprise a coding region comprising an expression sequence. In some embodiments, the precursor RNA polynucleotide comprises a monotron. In some embodiments, the circular RNA has improved expression, functional stability, immunogenicity, ease of manufacturing, and/or half-life when compared to linear RNA. patents.abstract: A method for covalently joining linear RNA molecules end-to-end to extend their functionality. A cis-acting ligase ribozyme is used to generate circular RNA in vitro for ectopic protein expression. Furthermore, one internal ribosome entry site rendered oRNA translation competent, but two IRES in cis, not tans, hampered the translation and an oRNA expressing ribonuclease Cas13 showed excellent potential against the corresponding RNA virus. A method for using oRNA is also provided.

Also provided are a method for preparing the isolated antigen-binding protein and the use thereof.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes isolated antigen-binding proteins (likely monoclonal antibodies or antibody-like molecules) that specifically target TIGIT and block its interaction with CD155, with demonstrated tumor growth inhibition activity. This is significant for CAR-T therapy as TIGIT blockade can enhance T cell effector function and overcome immune exhaustion, potentially improving CAR-T cell persistence and anti-tumor efficacy when used as a combination therapeutic.

patents.title: PROTÉINE DE LIAISON À L'ANTIGÈNE BISPÉCIFIQUE ANTI-CLDN18.2 ET 4-1BB ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: An isolated antigen binding protein, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. The antigen binding protein comprises: a first antigen binding domain and a second antigen binding domain, wherein the first antigen binding domain can specifically bind to claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2), and the first antigen binding domain contains at least one CDR in an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO: 100.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a novel bispecific antigen-binding protein that simultaneously targets claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2) and 4-1BB, combining tumor-associated antigen recognition with T cell costimulation. This represents a differentiated approach to in vivo CAR-T enhancement by using a soluble bispecific rather than solely engineering the CAR itself, potentially improving T cell activation and persistence while reducing systemic toxicity through localized costimulation at the tumor microenvironment.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE CIBLANT GPRC5D ET SON APPLICATION
patents.abstract: The present application relates to a chimeric antigen receptor, comprising a first antigen binding domain and a second antigen binding domain. The first antigen binding domain targets a G protein-coupled receptor class C group 5 member D (GPRC5D) protein, and the second antigen binding domain targets the GPRC5D protein. The present application further provides a cell comprising the chimeric antigen receptor and use thereof.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: A dual-targeting CAR construct with two independent antigen-binding domains both directed against GPRC5D, a validated multiple myeloma target. This tandem domain architecture may enhance antigen recognition avidity or provide functional redundancy, offering potential competitive advantages in CAR-T potency and durability for GPRC5D+ malignancies.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE CIBLANT CLDN18.2 ET MSLN ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided is a cell, comprising a chimeric antigen receptor that expresses and/or targets claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2), and a chimeric antigen receptor that targets mesothelin (MSLN) protein. Also provided is an expression vector, comprising a nucleic acid sequence which encodes the chimeric antigen receptor that targets CLDN18.2, and a nucleic acid sequence which encodes the chimeric antigen receptor that targets MSLN. Also provided are a preparation method for and a use of the cell and/or the expression vector.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims cells engineered with dual chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) targeting both CLDN18.2 and MSLN, along with expression vectors encoding these dual-targeting CARs and their preparation methods. This dual-CAR approach targeting two tumor-associated antigens simultaneously represents a strategy to expand CAR-T therapeutic potential for solid tumors expressing these antigens (particularly gastric and pancreatic cancers), with competitive significance in addressing tumor heterogeneity and antigen escape.

patents.title: PROTÉINE DE LIAISON À L'ANTIGÈNE CIBLANT LA MSLN ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: An isolated antigen binding protein, capable of targeting MSLN. The isolated antigen binding protein comprises at least one CDR in an antibody heavy chain variable region VH, and the VH comprises an amino acid sequence shown in any one of SEQ ID NO: 8, SEQ ID NO: 13, SEQ ID NO: 69, and SEQ ID NO: 70. Also provided are a chimeric antigen receptor comprising the antigen binding protein, and the use of the antigen binding protein in treating tumors.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes isolated antigen binding proteins (antibodies) targeting MSLN with specific VH sequences, and their incorporation into chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) for tumor treatment. The novelty lies in the particular CDR and VH sequence combinations for MSLN targeting, which is clinically significant as MSLN is a validated tumor-associated antigen for CAR-T cell therapy in mesothelioma and pancreatic cancer indications.

patents.title: PROTÉINE DE LIAISON À L'ANTIGÈNE ANTI-GPRC5D ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: An isolated antigen binding protein, the antigen binding protein binding the protein G protein-coupled receptor, class C, group 5, member D (GPRC5D) at an EC50 value of 1.0 μg/mL. A chimeric antigen receptor comprising the antigen binding protein, and a use thereof in the treatment of tumors.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents an anti-GPRC5D antigen binding protein with specified EC50 binding kinetics incorporated into a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) construct for tumor treatment. GPRC5D is a validated multiple myeloma target, and the novelty centers on the particular binding affinity of this antibody/binding protein and its CAR-T application, though GPRC5D-targeting CAR-Ts have been explored clinically by competitors.

patents.title: RECEPTEUR ANTIGENIQUE CHIMERIQUE ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: [0001]    The present application relates to a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), comprising a GPC3 binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain and an intracellular signaling domain, the GPC3 binding domain comprises an antibody or a fragment thereof which specifically binding to GPC3, the antibody comprises a light chain complementary determining region 1 (LCDR1), a light chain complementary determining region 2 (LCDR2) and a light chain complementary determining region 3 (LCDR3), the amino acid sequence of the LCDR1 is as set forth in SEQ ID NO: 16, the amino acid sequence of the LCDR2 is as set forth in SEQ ID NO: 17 and the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is as set forth in SEQ ID NO: 18. The present application also relates to an isolated nucleic acid encoding the CAR, a vector comprising the nucleic acid, an immune effector cell comprising the nucleic acid or the vector and a preparation method thereof as well as a use of the CAR.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a GPC3-targeting CAR with defined light chain CDRs (LCDR1-3) derived from a specific antibody, enabling recognition of glypican-3 expressed on hepatocellular carcinoma and other solid tumors. This represents a structurally defined CAR construct with potential competitive advantage in solid tumor targeting, an area where CAR-T efficacy remains clinically challenging.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE CIBLANT BCMA ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided are a BCMA-targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and the use thereof. The CAR comprises a BCMA binding domain, and the BCMA binding domain comprises an antibody specifically binding to BCMA or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, wherein the antibody comprises a light chain complementarity determining region 3 (HCDR3), and the HCDR3 comprises an amino acid sequence as shown in SEQ ID NO: 25. Further provided are an immune effector cell and a pharmaceutical composition comprising the CAR, and a method for treating diseases or conditions associated with BCMA expression.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a BCMA-targeting CAR with a specific antibody-derived binding domain featuring a defined HCDR3 sequence (SEQ ID NO: 25), along with immune effector cells and pharmaceutical compositions. The novelty centers on the particular CDR sequences and their application to BCMA+ hematologic malignancies; competitive significance depends on the CDR design's affinity/specificity advantages and whether the sequence claim provides freedom-to-operate barriers against existing BCMA-CAR-T therapies (e.g., idecabtagene vicleucel).

patents.title: PROTÉINE DE LIAISON À L'ANTIGÈNE CIBLANT LA CLDN18.2, ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided is an isolated antigen-binding protein capable of binding to CLDN18.2. Also included is a chimeric antigen receptor of the isolated antigen-binding protein. Further provided are a method for preparing the antigen-binding protein or the chimeric antigen receptor, and the use thereof.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents isolated antigen-binding proteins targeting CLDN18.2 and their incorporation into chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), along with methods for their preparation. This is significant for in vivo CAR-T therapy as CLDN18.2 is a validated tumor-associated antigen expressed in gastric and pancreatic cancers, offering a potentially safer target than pan-cancer antigens with reduced off-target toxicity.

patents.title: PROTÉINE DE LIAISON À L'ANTIGÈNE CLDN18.2 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided is an isolated antigen-binding protein, capable of binding to CLDN18.2. Also provided are a chimeric antigen receptor comprising the isolated antigen binding protein, and a preparation method for and an application of the antigen binding protein and the chimeric antigen receptor.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 原启生物科技（上海）有限责任公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents an isolated antigen-binding protein targeting CLDN18.2 (claudin-18.2) and its integration into chimeric antigen receptors (CARs), along with preparation and application methods. CLDN18.2 is a tumor-associated antigen relevant to gastric and other cancers, making this potentially significant for expanding CAR-T therapy to additional solid tumor indications beyond hematologic malignancies, though the abstract provides limited specificity on binding domain architecture or functional improvements.

patents.title: ANTI-PD-L1 ANTIBODY AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: Provided are an antibody that binds to the PD-L1 protein or CD137 protein, an antigen-binding fragment or a variant thereof, as well as a bispecific antibody that can bind to both the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein. The bispecific antibody has a strong ability to specifically recognize the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein, and can enhance T-cell activity. Also provided is the use of the antibody or the antigen-binding fragment or the variant thereof and the bispecific antibody in the prevention and treatment of tumors.
patents.assignee: ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents bispecific antibodies that simultaneously bind PD-L1 and CD137 (4-1BB), combining immune checkpoint inhibition with costimulatory activation to enhance T-cell function in tumor contexts. This dual-targeting approach offers competitive advantage over monotherapies by potentially amplifying anti-tumor T-cell responses without requiring separate antibody administrations.

patents.title: MODIFIZIERTE IMMUNZELLE UND VERWENDUNG DAVON
patents.abstract: [0001]    Provided is a modified immune cell, comprising a chimeric antigen receptor and/or a coding element therefor, or comprising a T cell receptor and/or a coding element therefor. The immune cell further comprises: leptin and/or a functional fragment thereof; and/or, a leptin receptor and/or a functional fragment thereof, and the expression quantity of the leptin receptor and/or the functional fragment thereof in the immune cell is increased compared with that in an immune cell without the corresponding modification. In addition, also provided is another modified immune cell, comprising leptin and/or a functional fragment thereof, and/or, a leptin receptor and/or a functional fragment thereof, and a low-density lipoprotein-receptor-related protein or a fragment thereof.
patents.assignee: ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; Oricell Therapeutics Co., Ltd.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims modified immune cells (CAR-T or TCR-engineered) with enhanced leptin and/or leptin receptor expression, or co-expression with LDL-receptor-related protein. This metabolic engineering approach aims to improve T cell persistence, proliferation, and anti-tumor function by leveraging leptin signaling pathways. The competitive significance lies in addressing T cell exhaustion and metabolic dysfunction in solid tumors, representing a differentiated approach to CAR-T enhancement beyond standard co-stimulatory domain optimization.

patents.title: ANTI-PD-L1 ANTIBODY AND USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: An antibody that binds to the PD-L1 protein or CD137 protein, an antigen-binding fragment or a variant thereof, as well as a bispecific antibody that can bind to both the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein. The bispecific antibody has a strong ability to specifically recognize the PD-L1 protein and the CD137 protein, and can enhance T-cell activity. The antibody or the antigen-binding fragment or the variant thereof and the bispecific antibody may be used in the prevention and treatment of tumors.
patents.assignee: ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes bispecific antibodies capable of simultaneously binding PD-L1 and CD137 (4-1BB) to enhance T-cell activity in tumor treatment. This is potentially significant for in vivo CAR-T therapy as dual checkpoint blockade (PD-L1 inhibition) combined with costimulatory signaling (CD137 engagement) could amplify CAR-T cell proliferation, persistence, and anti-tumor function without requiring ex vivo engineering modifications.

patents.title: METHOD FOR PROMOTING IMMUNE CELL PROLIFERATION
patents.abstract: Disclosed is a method for promoting immune cell proliferation. The method comprises the following step: upregulating the expression of low-density lipoprotein receptor-related proteins or fragments thereof in immune cells.
patents.assignee: ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORICELL THERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; ORIGINCELL THERAPEUTICS CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a method for enhancing immune cell proliferation through upregulation of low-density lipoprotein receptor-related proteins (LRP) or their fragments. This approach could be relevant to CAR-T manufacturing by potentially improving expansion efficiency during ex vivo T cell engineering, though the mechanism and specificity for CAR-T applications require further clarification from the full specification.

patents.title: Fully human antibody targeting BAFF-R
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody or a single-chain antibody or a fragment thereof targeting BAFF-R, the fully humanized antibody or the single-chain antibody or the fragment thereof is combined with BAFF-R with high affinity and high specificity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the fully humanized antibody or the single-chain antibody or the fragment thereof has lower immunogenicity and has good application potential in development of antibody drugs (including monoclonal antibodies, double antibodies, antibody coupling drugs (ADC) and the like) and cell therapy drugs (including CAR-T, CAR-NK and the like).
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes fully humanized antibodies and single-chain antibody fragments targeting BAFF-R with high affinity and specificity, designed to reduce immunogenicity compared to heterologous antibodies. While BAFF-R targeting is not novel per se, the fully humanized format and claimed application to CAR-T engineering represent incremental advancement, though the patent provides minimal mechanistic detail on how BAFF-R engagement enhances CAR-T function or persistence.

patents.title: Bispecific CAR-T cell targeting BCMA and GPRC5D
patents.abstract: The present invention provides a bispecific CAR-T cell that targets BCMA and GPRC5D, and a method for preparing the bispecific CAR-T cell. Specifically, the invention provides an autologous CAR-T cell which simultaneously aims at BCMA and GPRC5D antigen molecules and expresses a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) in parallel. The invention also provides application of the CAR-T cell in adoptive T cell therapy of diseases such as multiple myeloma.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; SHANGHAI XUNLU BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention presents a bispecific CAR-T cell with dual targeting of BCMA and GPRC5D antigens expressed in parallel, enabling simultaneous engagement of both tumor-associated antigens on multiple myeloma cells. This dual-targeting approach offers potential competitive advantages in reducing antigen escape and improving therapeutic efficacy compared to single-target CAR-T cells, while the parallel CAR expression architecture may provide improved functional characteristics for in vivo persistence and tumor control.

patents.title: Chimeric antigen receptor immune cells targeting BAFF-R and CD19
patents.abstract: The invention provides a chimeric antigen receptor immune cell targeting BAFF-R and CD19, and a preparation method of the chimeric antigen receptor immune cell. The invention provides bispecific CAR-T cells with series and parallel structures, and the bispecific CAR-T cells have obvious killing ability on target cells expressing BAFF-R and/or CD19. The CAR-T cell provided by the invention makes up the problem of target loss possibly caused by single-target CAR, is expected to achieve a better curative effect on CD19 negative or recurrent B cell lymphoma patients, covers a wider patient group, and has application prospects in the field of tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The invention describes bispecific CAR-T cells with dual targeting of BAFF-R and CD19 in both series and parallel configurations, designed to overcome antigen escape and target loss associated with single-target CAR-T therapy. This addresses clinical resistance in CD19-negative or relapsed B-cell lymphomas, potentially expanding the treatable patient population beyond conventional CD19-only CAR-T approaches.

patents.title: Completely human antibody targeting CD33
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD33 and an application of the fully humanized antibody. Specifically, the invention provides a CD33 targeting antibody with a brand new sequence, a chimeric antigen receptor constructed based on the antibody or an antigen binding fragment thereof, and an immune cell for expressing the chimeric antigen receptor. The antibody can be highly specifically combined with a CD33 antigen, has very high affinity and remarkable anti-tumor activity, and can be used for preparing medicines for treating diseases related to CD33.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a fully humanized anti-CD33 antibody with novel sequences and a derived CAR construct with high affinity and specificity for CD33. This is significant for in vivo CAR-T therapy targeting CD33+ hematologic malignancies (AML, CLL), as improved antibody sequences can enhance CAR-T cell recognition, persistence, and anti-tumor activity while potentially reducing immunogenicity.

patents.title: Fully humanized antibody targeting BAFF-R and application thereof in CAR-T treatment
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting BAFF-R and an application of the fully humanized antibody in CAR-T (Chimeric Antigen Receptor-T) treatment. According to the present invention, the BAFF-R targeting completely human antibody or the antigen binding fragment thereof is obtained through screening of the completely human phage library, and is specifically bound with BAFF-R with high affinity; based on the screened antibody sequence, the invention provides a fully human chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting BAFF-R and a host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell, and provides application of the CAR and the CAR-T cell in the aspect of B cell tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a fully humanized anti-BAFF-R antibody discovered through human phage library screening, and its application as a CAR construct for engineering CAR-T cells targeting B cell malignancies. The competitive significance lies in providing a fully human (non-chimeric) antibody-derived CAR targeting BAFF-R, potentially reducing immunogenicity compared to murine-derived CARs and enabling B cell depletion-based immunotherapy for B cell lymphomas and leukemias.

patents.title: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN ET CELLULE CAR-T CIBLANT BAFF-R ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: A fully human single-domain antibody, a monoclonal antibody, a bispecific antibody, and a CAR-T cell targeting BAFF-R and a use thereof. Provided are a fully human antibody or antigen-binding fragment thereof targeting BAFF-R and obtained by means of screening a fully human phage library, a fully human chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting BAFF-R, and an immune cell expressing the CAR. Further provided is a bispecific antibody targeting BAFF-R and CD3 in different combination configurations. Further provided is a use of the foregoing antibodies and the CAR-immune cell in the treatment of B cell tumors.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; NANJING IASO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers fully human anti-BAFF-R antibodies derived from phage display library screening, CAR-T cells targeting BAFF-R, and bispecific antibodies targeting BAFF-R and CD3 for B cell malignancies. The novelty lies in the specific targeting of BAFF-R (a validated B cell survival antigen) via engineered human antibodies and CAR-T constructs, potentially offering improved therapeutic efficacy and reduced immunogenicity compared to chimeric or humanized alternatives in B cell lymphomas and leukemias.

patents.title: Preparation and application of targeted BAFF-R and CD3 bispecific antibody
patents.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biology, in particular to an anti-BAFF-R and anti-CD3 bispecific antibody and application thereof. The bispecific antibody disclosed by the invention can be specifically combined with a cell surface B cell activating factor receptor (BAFF-R) and an immune cell surface antigen molecular cluster 3 (CD3); wherein the anti-BAFF-R antibody is a full human source single domain antibody. The invention also provides a preparation method of the bispecific antibody with different combination configurations of 1 + 1, 2 + 1 and 2 + 2 and an in-vitro and in-vivo biological activity evaluation method. The bispecific antibody disclosed by the invention has relatively high affinity and can be used for treating BAFFR expressed tumor diseases and autoimmune diseases.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a BAFF-R/CD3 bispecific antibody with full human single domain antibody architecture against BAFF-R, designed to redirect T cells (via CD3) to BAFF-R+ B cell malignancies and autoimmune diseases. The novelty lies in the specific domain configurations (1+1, 2+1, 2+2) and dual targeting approach, offering potential competitive advantage for B-cell lymphomas and B-cell driven autoimmune disorders through T cell redirection without requiring genetic modification.

patents.title: Completely humanized antibody targeting CD22 and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention relates to the field of antibodies, and provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD22 and application thereof. The invention provides an anti-CD22 fully humanized single-domain antibody, which is combined with CD22 with high affinity and high specificity, has lower immunogenicity and side effect, and has good application potential in development of medicines for treating diseases related to CD22.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI XUNLU BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized single-domain antibody (sdAb) targeting CD22 with claimed high affinity and specificity, reduced immunogenicity compared to non-humanized counterparts. While CD22 is a validated B-cell target in CAR-T therapy, the novelty here is limited to the antibody format itself rather than novel therapeutic mechanism or delivery approach; the competitive significance depends on binding kinetics and manufacturing advantages of the sdAb format versus existing anti-CD22 antibodies.

patents.title: Antibody targeting BCMA and application thereof
patents.abstract: The present application provides an antibody that targets BCMA. The invention also provides different forms of recombinant receptor molecules constructed through the antigen binding domain of the antibody, and nucleic acid molecules and expression vectors encoding the antibody and the recombinant receptor molecules. The present application also relates to the use of said antibodies, including recombinant receptors of CAR molecules, in the treatment of disease, in particular in the treatment of multiple bone marrow cancer.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes antibodies targeting BCMA with recombinant receptor molecules (including CAR constructs) derived from the antibody's antigen-binding domain, along with their use in treating multiple myeloma and related bone marrow cancers. The novelty centers on alternative BCMA-targeting CAR designs using antibody-derived binding domains rather than conventional scFv approaches, potentially offering improved specificity or manufacturability for in vivo CAR-T applications in hematologic malignancies.

patents.title: Chimeric molecule receptor of dual-targeting BCMA/GPRC5D and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a bispecific antibody and a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) which are targeted to BCMA and GPRC5D. The invention also provides a nucleic acid molecule for coding the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor, an expression vector containing the nucleic acid molecule, and a cell for expressing the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor. The invention also relates to application of the bispecific antibody and the chimeric antigen receptor in disease treatment, in particular to application in treatment of multiple bone marrow cancer.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a dual-targeting CAR engineered to recognize both BCMA and GPRC5D antigens, along with bispecific antibody variants. The competitive significance lies in addressing antigen escape and heterogeneous expression in multiple myeloma by simultaneously engaging two validated tumor-associated antigens, potentially improving efficacy over single-targeted BCMA CAR-T approaches currently in clinical use.

patents.title: CELLULE CAR-T UNIVERSELLE CIBLANT CD5 ET CD7 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided herein is a method for preparing a universal chimeric antigen receptor T (UCAR-T) cell, comprising: knocking out genes such as TRAC, B2M, CD5 and CD7 in a T cell, and transfecting the T cell to enable the expression of a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting a tumor cell. Also provided herein is a preferred sgRNA for gene knockout. The UCAR-T cell provided herein can be used for treating cancers.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a universal CAR-T (UCAR-T) cell generated by knockout of TRAC, B2M, CD5, and CD7 genes combined with transfection to express a tumor-targeting CAR. The multi-gene knockout approach (particularly the dual knockout of CD5 and CD7) is designed to reduce immunogenicity and enable off-the-shelf allogeneic CAR-T therapy, addressing a key clinical limitation of autologous CAR-T manufacturing.

patents.title: CELLULE EXPRIMANT UN RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) CIBLANT CD5 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: A chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) specifically binding to a CD5 protein, comprising a CD5 binding domain, a transmembrane domain, a co-stimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain. Further provided is an engineered immune effector cell (such as a T cell) comprising the CAR. Further provided is a use of the CAR and the engineered immune effector cell in the treatment of diseases or symptoms related to expression of CD5.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims a CD5-targeting CAR construct with standard modular architecture (binding domain, transmembrane, co-stimulatory, and intracellular signaling domains) integrated into engineered T cells for treatment of CD5-expressing diseases. The competitive significance lies in targeting CD5+ malignancies (particularly T-cell lymphomas and chronic lymphocytic leukemia), though CD5-targeting CAR-Ts represent an emerging but relatively crowded therapeutic space with potential for autoimmunity due to CD5 expression on normal T cells.

patents.title: Antibody targeting GPRC5D and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a GPRC5D-targeted antibody and application thereof, the GPRC5D-targeted antibody comprises a heavy chain variable region and a light chain variable region, the amino acid sequence of LCDR1 is ENIYSY, and the amino acid sequence of LCDR2 is NAK; the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is QHHYGTPYT, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR1 is GFTFSSYG, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR2 is ISNRGTYI, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR3 is ARPRQIGIFDY, or the amino acid sequence of the LCDR1 is QSLNSGNQKNY, and the amino acid sequence of the LCDR2 is GAS; the amino acid sequence of the LCDR3 is QQHYSTPYT, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR1 is GFTFSSYG, the amino acid sequence of the HCDR2 is ISNRGTYI, and the amino acid sequence of the HCDR3 is ARPRQIGIFDY.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIO TECH CO LTD; NANJING IASO BIOPHARMACEUTICAL CO LTD; 南京驯鹿生物技术股份有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent claims novel GPRC5D-targeted antibodies with specific CDR sequences (two variants provided with defined LCDR1-3 and HCDR1-3 sequences). GPRC5D is a multiple myeloma antigen, and these antibodies are significant for CAR-T applications as they could serve as targeting moieties for CAR-T cell engineering, enabling selective recognition and elimination of GPRC5D+ malignant cells in myeloma patients.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) ENTIÈREMENT HUMANISÉ CIBLANT GPRC5D ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided herein is a GPRC5D-targeting fully humanized chimeric antigen receptor (CAR). Further provided herein is a host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell. Also provided herein is the use of the CAR and the CAR-T cell in the treatment of tumors (e.g. multiple myeloma).
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes a fully humanized GPRC5D-targeting CAR and CAR-T cells engineered to express this receptor, with application to multiple myeloma and other tumors. The competitive significance lies in the use of complete humanization (rather than chimeric mouse-human constructs) to potentially reduce immunogenicity and improve in vivo persistence and efficacy in CAR-T therapy.

patents.title: ANTICORPS ENTIÈREMENT HUMAIN CIBLANT GPRC5D
patents.abstract: Provided is a fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D, or an antigen-binding fragment thereof, comprising a fully human antibody, which specifically binds to GPRC5D with a high affinity. Further provided are a fusion protein, bispecific antibody and immunoconjugate comprising the fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D, or the antigen-binding fragment thereof, and the use thereof in detection and treatment.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes fully human monoclonal antibodies targeting GPRC5D with high affinity, along with bispecific antibody and immunoconjugate formats derived from these antibodies. GPRC5D is a validated target for multiple myeloma and other hematologic malignancies, making these antibody constructs potentially valuable for CAR-T cell engineering as targeting agents, though the patent itself does not explicitly describe CAR-T applications.

patents.title: ANTICORPS ENTIEREMENT HUMAIN CIBLANT GPRC5D ET RECEPTEUR ANTIGENIQUE CHIMERIQUE (CAR) ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: A fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D and a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) comprising the fully human antibody. A host cell expressing the CAR, such as a CAR-T cell. A use of the fully human antibody, the CAR, and the CAR-T cell in treatment of tumors (such as multiple myeloma).
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a fully human antibody targeting GPRC5D integrated into a CAR construct, combined with CAR-T cell therapeutic applications for tumor treatment, particularly multiple myeloma. The competitive significance lies in providing a humanized targeting moiety against GPRC5D—a validated multiple myeloma antigen—which may reduce immunogenicity and improve clinical efficacy compared to chimeric or murine-derived antibodies in CAR-T therapeutics.

patents.title: Immune cell for killing escape allosome NK cells and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides an immune cell for killing an escape allosome NK cell and application of the immune cell. The function of a CD58 gene of the immune cell is inhibited. According to the invention, a series of researches are carried out on the CD58 gene, and attack and killing of universal CAR-T escape host NK and T cells are realized through knockout modification of CD58. The universal CAR-T cell designed by the invention can effectively escape from killing of allosome NK cells, and a brand new strategy for killing of the universal CAR-T cell escaping from host NK cells is provided.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes engineered immune cells (CAR-T) with CD58 gene inhibition/knockout to evade killing by allogeneic NK cells, while simultaneously retaining capacity to kill host NK and T cells that would otherwise eliminate the CAR-T product. This addresses a critical failure mode in allogeneic CAR-T therapy where host NK cell-mediated rejection limits persistence and efficacy of universal CAR-T products.

patents.title: Fully humanized antibody, single-chain antibody and antigen binding fragment of targeted BAFF-R antigen
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody, a single-chain antibody and an antigen binding fragment of a targeted BAFF-R antigen, the fully humanized antibody, the single-chain antibody and the antigen binding fragment of the targeted BAFF-R antigen are combined with the BAFF-R antigen with high affinity and high specificity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the fully humanized antibody, the single-chain antibody and the antigen binding fragment have lower immunogenicity and can be used for preparing the BAFF-R antigen. The method has good application potential in development of antibody drugs and cell therapy drugs.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS TECH CO LTD; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes fully humanized antibodies and single-chain antibody fragments targeting BAFF-R with claimed high affinity/specificity and reduced immunogenicity compared to heterologous antibodies. For in vivo CAR-T applications, BAFF-R targeting could enable modulation of B cell survival and immune tolerance, though the patent provides no specific CAR-T construct design, functional validation data, or mechanistic details demonstrating competitive advantage in engineered T cell therapies.

patents.title: Completely humanized antibody targeting CD7 and application thereof
patents.abstract: The invention provides a fully humanized antibody targeting CD7 and application of the fully humanized antibody. The CD7-targeted fully humanized antibody is specifically combined with CD7 with high affinity, and compared with a heterologous antibody, the CD7-targeted fully humanized antibody has lower immunogenicity and has good application potential in development of antibody drugs including monoclonal antibodies, double antibodies, antibody coupling drugs and the like and cell therapy drugs including CAR-T, CAR-NK and the like.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECH CO LTD; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: A fully humanized anti-CD7 antibody with high affinity and reduced immunogenicity compared to chimeric or humanized counterparts. The antibody is applicable as a standalone therapeutic and as a component in CAR-T and CAR-NK cell engineering, offering potential competitive advantage through improved tolerability and reduced anti-drug immune responses in cellular therapy contexts.

patents.title: APPLICATION DE CAR-T BCMA DANS LA PRÉPARATION D'UN MÉDICAMENT POUR LE TRAITEMENT DE MALADIES AUTO-IMMUNES
patents.abstract: Provided is an application of an immune effector cell in the preparation of a drug for preventing and/or treating autoimmune diseases. The immune effector cell comprises a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), wherein the CAR comprises an antigen binding domain targeting BCMA, a transmembrane domain, a costimulatory domain, and an intracellular signaling domain, wherein the antigen binding domain is a fully human antigen binding domain.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a repurposing of BCMA-targeting CAR-T cells, traditionally used in oncology for B-cell malignancies, for treatment of autoimmune diseases through a fully human antigen binding domain approach. This represents a significant shift in CAR-T therapeutic application—leveraging BCMA as a target on pathogenic B cells in autoimmunity rather than malignant plasma cells, potentially offering a new therapeutic modality for conditions currently treated with conventional immunosuppressants.

patents.title: RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE ENTIÈREMENT HUMANISÉ (CAR) POUR CIBLES DOUBLES CD5 ET CD7 ET SON UTILISATION
patents.abstract: A CAR targeting CD5 and/or CD7, a host cell expressing the CAR targeting CD5 and/or CD7, and a preparation method therefor and the use thereof in treating T-cell-related tumors.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses a fully humanized CAR targeting dual antigens (CD5 and/or CD7) for T-cell malignancies, with methods for generating CAR-expressing host cells and their therapeutic application. The dual-targeting approach to CD5/CD7 represents a clinically relevant strategy for treating T-cell lymphomas and leukemias, offering potential advantages in specificity and efficacy over single-antigen CARs by addressing antigen escape.

patents.title: PRÉPARATION POUR CELLULES À RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE (CAR) AMÉLIORÉES ET LEUR UTILISATION
patents.abstract: Provided is an immune cell capable of expressing multiple components. The immune cell comprises two types of chimeric antigen receptors. The first type of chimeric antigen receptor can enhance the proliferation or activity of immune cells. The immune cell can also express competitive receptors with a missing function such as dNTGF-βRII, can solve the problem of immunosuppressive microenvironments existing in solid tumor tissues, and has a greatly improved ability to kill solid tumors. Meanwhile, the immune cell also expresses a tEGFR molecule, CAR-T cells in vivo can be effectively removed by means of injecting an antibody for EGFR, and a security risk caused by the CAR-T cells is safeguarded against.
patents.assignee: NANJING IASO BIOTHERAPEUTICS CO LTD [CN]; 南京驯鹿医疗技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes dual CAR-T cells engineered with two types of chimeric antigen receptors—one enhancing proliferation/activity and another designed to counteract immunosuppression in solid tumors via a dominant-negative TGF-β receptor (dNTGF-βRII). A novel safety feature involves co-expression of a truncated EGFR (tEGFR) enabling rapid in vivo elimination via anti-EGFR antibody administration, addressing a critical clinical concern for CAR-T therapy in solid tumors while providing controllable off-switch capability.

patents.title: CELLULE SOUCHE HÉMATOPOÏÉTIQUE GÉNÉTIQUEMENT MODIFIÉE ET SON UTILISATION EN COMBINAISON AVEC LYMPHOCYTE CAR-T
patents.abstract: Provided are a method for changing an antigenic epitope of a cell, and a cell prepared by means of using the method. Further provided are a method and a pharmaceutical composition for treating tumors by means of using the cell in combination with a CAR-T cell or an antibody drug. The cell with the changed antigenic epitope is not killed by the CAR-T or the antibody drug, and can be infused into a patient to alleviate the side effects of a CAR-T product or an antibody drug in tumor treatment.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents genetically modified hematopoietic stem cells engineered to lack or alter antigenic epitopes recognized by CAR-T cells, enabling co-infusion with CAR-T therapies to mitigate toxicity and side effects while maintaining therapeutic efficacy. This represents a novel approach to managing CAR-T-related cytotoxicity by engineering supportive cells that escape CAR-T recognition, offering significant clinical advantage in reducing off-target toxicity during CAR-T treatment.

patents.title: LYMPHOCYTE T RÉCEPTEUR ANTIGÉNIQUE CHIMÉRIQUE UNIVERSEL ET SON APPLICATION
patents.abstract: A cell comprising a mutant protein, the mutant protein causing the cell to be insensitive toward an inhibitor which affects the activity and/or killing function thereof; a universal chimeric antigen receptor T cell which is related to the cell and which is suitable for administration to non-specific patients; and a method for preparing the described cells and an application of the cells in cell therapy.
patents.assignee: SHANGHAI IASO BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD [CN]; 上海驯鹿生物技术有限公司
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes universal CAR-T cells engineered with mutant proteins conferring insensitivity to inhibitors that suppress T cell activity and killing function, enabling off-the-shelf administration across non-specific patients. The competitive significance lies in addressing a key limitation of autologous CAR-T therapy—manufacturing delays and patient-to-patient variability—through an allogeneic approach with built-in resistance to immunosuppressive signals, potentially enabling rapid deployment and reduced manufacturing costs.

patents.title: Neutralizing monoclonal antibodies targeting single chain antibodies
patents.abstract: The invention relates to a neutralizing monoclonal antibody targeting a single-chain antibody, in particular to a separated antigen binding protein, and the antigen comprises a chimeric antigen receptor targeting a B cell maturation antigen (BCMA).
