Dans certains modes de réalisation, les méthodes comprennent des mélanges réactionnels, et des formulations de cellules résultantes, qui sont créées
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]; EXUMA BIOTECH CORP.
patents.novelty_summary: This patent presents methods for generating CAR-T cells directly from whole blood or non-PBMC blood components using retroviral transduction, combined with subcutaneous reintroduction of modified lymphocytes and polynucleotides enabling CAR-responsive cell survival/proliferation regulation. The competitive significance lies in streamlining CAR-T manufacturing by eliminating the PBMC isolation step and introducing a potentially more accessible subcutaneous administration route rather than standard intravenous dosing.

patents.title: Methods and compositions for genetically modifying lymphocytes in blood or in enriched PBMCs
patents.abstract: The present disclosure provides methods and compositions for genetically modifying lymphocytes, for example T cells and/or NK cells, in shorter times than previously and/or in whole blood or a component thereof. In some embodiments a lymphodepletion filter assembly is used before or after forming a reaction mixture where lymphocytes are contacted with recombinant retroviral particles in a closed system, to genetically modify the lymphocytes.
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]; EXUMA BIOTECH, CORP
patents.novelty_summary: The patent presents methods for rapid genetic modification of T cells and NK cells directly in whole blood or enriched PBMCs using a lymphodepletion filter assembly in a closed system with retroviral particles. The competitive significance lies in reducing processing time and complexity by eliminating the need for extensive cell enrichment or isolation steps prior to transduction, potentially lowering manufacturing costs and improving cell viability for CAR-T production.

patents.title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS FOR TRANSDUCING AND EXPANDING LYMPHOCYTES AND REGULATING THE ACTIVITY THEREOF
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]
patents.novelty_summary: The patent describes methods and compositions for transducing and expanding lymphocytes with mechanisms to regulate their activity. This is relevant to CAR-T development as it addresses key manufacturing challenges: efficient transduction of T cells, ex vivo expansion, and activity control—critical for producing therapeutic CAR-T cells with predictable persistence and safety profiles.

patents.title: CHIMERIC ANTIGEN RECEPTORS AGAINST AXL OR ROR2 AND METHODS OF USE THEREOF
patents.abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure provides chimeric antigen receptors that bind to Axl and Ror2, and conditionally active chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) that recognize Axl and Ror2. Furthermore, provided herein are nucleic acids encoding these CARs and methods of making and using the CARs, including methods of treating cancer, especially cancers that express Axl and/or Ror2, such as renal cell carcinoma. The present disclosure provides cells genetically modified to produce the CARs.
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]; BIOATLA INC [US]; Exuma Biotech Corp.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses novel chimeric antigen receptors targeting AXL and ROR2 antigens, including conditionally active CAR variants, with specific application to renal cell carcinoma and other AXL/ROR2-expressing malignancies. The conditional activation mechanism and dual-antigen targeting strategy represent a competitive advance for improving CAR-T specificity and reducing off-target toxicity in solid tumors.

patents.title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS FOR TRANSDUCING LYMPHOCYTES AND REGULATING THE ACTIVITY THEREOF
patents.abstract: [0001]    The present disclosure provides methods for genetically modifying lymphocytes and methods for performing adoptive cellular therapy that include transducing T cells and/or NK cells. The methods can include inhibitory RNA molecule(s) and/or engineered signaling polypeptides that can include a lymphoproliferative element, and/or a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR), for example a microenvironment restricted biologic CAR (MRB-CAR). Additional elements of such engineered signaling polypeptides are provided herein, such as those that drive proliferation and regulatory elements therefor, as well as replication incompetent recombinant retroviral particles and packaging cell lines and methods of making the same. Numerous elements and methods for regulating transduced and/or genetically modified T cells and/or NK cells are provided, such as, for example, those including riboswitches, MRB-CARs, recognition domains, and/or pH-modulating agents.
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]; EXUMA BIOTECH CORP.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent covers engineered T/NK cells with microenvironment-restricted biologic CAR (MRB-CAR) designs that incorporate inhibitory RNA molecules and lymphoproliferative elements to regulate CAR activity in response to local tissue context. This approach addresses a key in vivo CAR-T challenge—limiting systemic toxicity and off-target activation by confining therapeutic activity to the tumor microenvironment—offering potential competitive advantage in safety-enhanced adoptive cellular therapy.

patents.title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS FOR TRANSDUCING LYMPHOCYTES AND REGULATED EXPANSION THEREOF
patents.assignee: EXUMA BIOTECH CORP [US]; Exuma Biotech, Corp.
patents.novelty_summary: The patent discloses methods and compositions for lymphocyte transduction with regulated expansion capabilities, likely enabling controlled proliferation of engineered T cells post-transduction. This addresses a key manufacturing and safety challenge in CAR-T therapy by decoupling transduction efficiency from uncontrolled expansion, potentially improving product consistency and reducing manufacturing timelines.
